lines: You pay for NetSuite and Planning every month.
But how much of it does your team actually use?
In one Planning application we reviewed, four people used it in six months.
Seventeen of one hundred fifty-five business rules ran.
And not one of its one hundred seventy-two forms was used to enter data.
In a NetSuite account, twenty-one of thirty-seven modules were in use.
Ninety-three accounts never had a single entry.
Bryant Park Consulting reads your system, not opinions.
We assess NetSuite and NetSuite Planning, and show you where you stand and what to fix first.
For NetSuite, all we need is a read-only connection.
For Planning, an application snapshot and six months of audit history.
From that, we build a report your finance team can act on.
You see what the system says about your business.
Every module, with evidence: in use, partly used, or not used at all.
Budgets built outside and loaded back in.
And the systems already connected around NetSuite, so nothing new duplicates them.
For Planning, you see which models are active and which have gone quiet.
Here, Workforce had been dormant for more than three months.
And every data change came through Smart View, so the forms built for budgeting were bypassed.
Every recommendation is tied to a number from your own system.
Clean up unused accounts before they reach Planning.
Plan your real seasonality.
Decide what to keep, and what to retire.
You get a written report, a walkthrough with your team, and a prioritized list of next steps.
Write to Bryant Park Consulting to request your assessment.
And get the most out of your implementation.
